data.one_liner: An Instagram-like text editor widget for editing text style, size, color, and alignment.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter widget that allows users to edit text styles including font family, size, color, and text alignment. It features a customizable design with palette colors and decorators similar to social media story editors.
use_when: You are building an image or story editor feature similar to Instagram.
You need a dedicated UI widget for customizing TextStyle and TextAlign.
avoid_when: You need a fully-featured rich text editor for documents or notes.
You require complex text formatting like bolding specific words, lists, or links.
strengths: Easy to integrate widget with customizable decoration.
Supports font family selection, size constraints, and color palettes.
weaknesses: Limited to whole-text style changes rather than selective rich text editing.
Relatively narrow scope focused mainly on Instagram-style text overlays.
